title: 白いひげ
theme: 白い毛は、この子と過ごした時間の証

slides.text:
ある朝、この子の顔に
見つけた白いもの
slides.scene: Morning light: close portrait of the senior dog looking up at the viewer; white hairs visible around its muzzle and eyebrows, gentle calm eyes.
slides.shot: close-up portrait, soft morning window light

slides.text:
いつものように、
朝ごはんを出した
slides.scene: The owner's hands set a food bowl down on the kitchen floor; the senior dog walks toward it.
slides.shot: low angle at the kitchen floor

slides.text:
器に顔を近づけるこの子を、
なんとなく見ていた
slides.scene: The senior dog eating from its bowl; the owner's legs and slippers nearby.

slides.text:
そのとき、
口のまわりが光って見えた
slides.scene: Sunlight catches the white hairs around the senior dog's muzzle as it lifts its head from the bowl.
slides.shot: close-up of the muzzle in sunlight

slides.text:
白い毛が、
いつのまにか増えていた
slides.scene: Close-up of the senior dog's face: white hairs mixed into the apricot fur around the mouth.

slides.text:
眉のあたりにも、
ちらほらと
slides.scene: Close-up of the senior dog's eyes with a few white hairs above them like eyebrows.

slides.text:
毎日見ていたのに、
気づかなかった
slides.scene: The owner kneels on the floor seen from behind, gently lifting the senior dog's chin with one hand to look at its face.

slides.text:
この子は、
私より早く年をとっている
slides.scene: Close-up of the senior dog resting on a cushion: clearly aged — many white hairs around the muzzle, chin and eyebrows, slightly thinner face, calm tired eyes — but healthy and peaceful.

slides.text:
スマホを開いて、
子犬の頃の写真を探した
slides.scene: The owner's hands hold a phone showing a drawing of a tiny apricot puppy; the senior dog rests beside the owner's knee.
slides.shot: close-up of hands and phone, the dog beside

slides.text:
ころころ転がる体、
まんまるの目
slides.scene: Memory vignette: the same dog as a tiny round fluffy puppy with floppy ears and big round eyes, tumbling happily on a rug.

slides.text:
今の寝顔と並べると、
同じ子なのに少し違う
slides.scene: Place two small vignettes side by side. Left: the dog as a young puppy, curled and asleep (small, very youthful features). Right: the same dog as a senior, curled in exactly the same pose and orientation but with visible signs of aging (graying/whitened muzzle, thinner/coarser fur, slight sagging around the eyes). Both should be on the same type of pillow/background so the age-related differences are clearly comparable.

slides.text:
でも、変わらないものも
ちゃんとある
slides.scene: The senior dog's tail wagging gently as it looks up.

slides.text:
名前を呼ぶと、
今もしっぽを振ってくれる
slides.scene: The senior dog trotting slowly toward the owner's outstretched hand, tail wagging.
slides.shot: low angle, the hand entering the frame

slides.text:
散歩の途中で、
今も私を振り返ってくれる
slides.scene: SIDE VIEW on an autumn path: the senior dog is on the LEFT half of the picture, walking toward the LEFT edge, and turns its head back to the RIGHT to look at the owner; the owner's legs (grey pants, white sneakers) walk a few steps BEHIND the dog on the RIGHT half, following it on a light-blue leash.
slides.shot: side view, the dog walking left and looking back right at the owner's legs

slides.text:
白いひげは、
この子と過ごした時間の証だ
slides.scene: Close-up of the owner's fingers gently touching the white hairs on the senior dog's muzzle.

slides.text:
この先の時間は、
きっと今より短い
slides.scene: The senior dog resting peacefully in a sunny spot on the floor, eyes softly closed, looking healthy and content.

slides.text:
だからこそ、
一日ずつを濃くしたい
slides.scene: The owner and the senior dog sitting side by side on the doorstep in the morning, seen from behind.

slides.text:
今日は、この子の好きな道を
ゆっくり歩こう
slides.scene: A slow walk on a tree-lined autumn path: the senior dog sniffing fallen leaves, the owner's legs walking slowly beside it.

slides.text:
白いひげごと、
ぜんぶ愛おしい
slides.scene: The owner hugs the senior dog on the sofa, seen from behind; the dog's white-muzzled face rests on the owner's shoulder.

slides.text:
あなたの子の白い毛に、
気づいた日はいつですか？
slides.scene: Close-up: the owner's fingers gently touch the clearly white hairs on the senior dog's muzzle while the dog rests its chin on the owner's knee in warm evening lamplight.
slides.shot: close-up of fingers, white muzzle and knee

caption:
白いひげは、この子と過ごした時間の証。
あなたの子の白い毛に気づいた日のこと、教えてください。
youtube_title: ある朝、この子の顔に見つけた白いもの
self_review: 病気・介護には触れず、年をとることを『時間の証』として肯定的に描く。7枚目『気づかなかった』は自責ではなく発見。16枚目は別れの語を使わない。
